summary.text: Drew Darby is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 72 who has represented the district since 2007 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is an attorney and title company owner.

paragraphs.text: Drew Darby earned a B.B.A. in finance and a J.D. from the University of Texas at Austin and graduated from the Emerging Political Leaders Program at the University of Virginia's Darden School of Business.
His professional experience includes owning Double D Title, Inc. and Surety Title Company and founding W. Drew Darby and Associates Law Firm.
Darby took office in the Texas House in 2007.
Ballotpedia lists his 2023-2024 committee assignments as Criminal Jurisprudence, Energy Resources, and Redistricting, which he chaired.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026, and faces Democrat Shiloh Salazar in the general election.
